statement: Pinned SDL Wii HIDAPI recognizes Nintendo vendor 0x057e products 0x0306 or 0x0330, identifies Wii U Pro from extension type 0x0120, renames the logical joystick Wii U Pro, and omits Wii Remote MotionPlus checks for that type.

applicability.revision: Wii U Pro; retail revision not measured
applicability.scope: SDL HIDAPI classifier and special-case routing; driver may require an enabled hint and device permissions.
